items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I had been knowin' him for years and didn't know he was a musician.

ctx.x: about Cookie, because I didn't know until years later that Cookie was even in a... I didn't know Cookie was a musician. I had been knowin' him for years and didn't know he was a musician. But at the time I met Cookie, I think he was a chauffeur for some big man downtown. He had a chauffeur's job. Every time I saw Cookie, he was all dressed up like he was a rich man or something. I didn't know he was even a musician.

Yeah, he would always be around the club... Oh, I actually thought he was a big-time gambler. Because he was around the Rhythm Club, where they gambled. Most of the time they had a big game goin' in there. And he would always be around, and I figured he was just another gambler hangin' around. Because he was dressed up all the time. He was very neat, you know.
